messages.author: cdec8e5095b55f43
messages.subject: Problem with define.sliders on Mac
parts:
Dear all,

I am having a problem with the define.sliders function (I'm working with 2d data) when using a Mac. I cannot select some of the landmarks in the plot window (all the landmarks I can't select seem to be confined to the bottom left corner of the window). I have no problems with this when using a PC.

I am using a 3 button mouse. I have tried changing the mouse settings in XQuartz but that did not fix the problem.

Here is my code:
sliders <- define.sliders(symphysis[,,1], nsliders = 25, write.file = T)

Please let me know if you have any suggestions! Thanks!

messages.author: 91722721526eb1d7
messages.subject: Re: Problem with define.sliders on Mac
parts:
Dear Clare,

There shouldn't be a difference between mac and PC when defining sliding semilandmarks in 2D since they both simply require left-click in the plot window of R on the circle representing the landmark. So I'm afraid I do not know the nature of your problem without more detail.

Emma
